class.name: OpenXRAndroidGlobalPassthroughDimmingExtension
class.brief_description: Allow requesting a global passthrough dimming level via the [code]XR_ANDROID_global_passthrough_dimming[/code] extension.
class.description: Allow requesting a global passthrough dimming level via the [code]XR_ANDROID_global_passthrough_dimming[/code] extension.

method.name: get_dimming_level
method.description: Gets the current global passthrough dimming level, with a range from [code]0.0[/code] (no dimming) to [code]1.0[/code] (maximum dimming).

method.name: get_supported_dimming_levels
method.description: Gets an array of the supported dimming levels on this device.

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this extension is supported on this device; otherwise, [code]false[/code].

method.name: set_dimming_level
method.description: Requests changing the current global passthrough dimming level, with a range from [code]0.0[/code] (no dimming) to [code]1.0[/code] (maximum dimming). This is only a request, which may be ignored or modified. You can call [method get_dimming_level] to get the actual dimming level, however, it won't be updated right away, so you may want to connect to [signal openxr_android_global_passthrough_dimming_level_changed].

signal.name: openxr_android_global_passthrough_dimming_level_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the global passthrough dimming level has changed, either due to calling [method set_dimming_level] or the user interacting with system controls.
